summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024: Falda Con Volantes ## Introduction Today, we are going to make a skirt with details of steering wheels. We will create a skirt of three levels or sections, and we will learn how to scale the skirt and create steering wheel patterns. Additionally, we will learn how to improve its quality and how to apply it with chiffon fabric. ## Downloading the Base File First, download and open the raffle skirt base file from the Barberous Designer channel in Connect. The file address is posted in the description of this video. As you can see, patterns of a basic shirt, pants, and the waist of the skirt have been created. ## Creating the Skirt Base For this skirt, we are going to create a design with many frills. We will create the skirt part using a semicircular pattern. In the 2D pattern window, select the ellipse tool. While you create the pattern, press **Shift + Control** to create a full circle from the center point. If you start with the mouse cursor on the waist of the avatar, you can estimate the length of the skirt according to the size of the radius of the circle. ## Adjusting the Pattern We eliminate the point to the left because we are going to convert it into a semicircle. In the center, we will create a curved line for the waist. Use the **Add Point-Divide Line** tool to create a center point using the guide line as a reference. We select the inner ellipse tool and click and drag from the center point to create a waist curve. Again, press **Ctrl + Shift** to create an inner circle around the center point. ## Sewing the Waist Sew the waist lines using the free sewing tool. Place and simulate the skirt pattern in the 3D window. You can curve it to the length you want. ## Creating the Wheel Pattern To create the wheel pattern, reorganize the skirt pattern using the 3D menu. The wheels are easier to place on flat patterns. Disable the arms of the avatar and hide the avatar. Cut the waist, set a center point, and eliminate the remaining pattern. ### Adding Wheel Lines We create the lines of the steering wheel for the skirt. Select the lines of the waist and the fold, and using the move tool as an internal line along the curve, add two internal lines. We create a wheel pattern by using the move tool as an internal line to create internal lines on both sides of the created internal shape. These are the lines that will form the wheel pattern. ## Configuring Wheel Size For the size, enter the desired width of the wheel pattern. I will add 20 mm. To create the opposite line, change the Invert Direction configuration. We use the **Clone Layer** menu on top to clone the pattern upwards. Then, we use the **Delete Link Editing** menu to eliminate the distance links between the two patterns. Select the lines that will become the wheel pattern and cut. Eliminate the other patterns, leaving only the wheel patterns. ## Finalizing the Skirt Pattern Freeze the skirt pattern while we create the wheels. Increase the size of the wheel pattern and simulate. If you are not satisfied with the results of the simulation, press **Ctrl + Z** to return to the previous state of the simulation. Then, change the size and simulate the wheel patterns again. ## Modifying Wheel Width Let's modify the width of the wheel. Select the contour we want to modify and select the **Move Pattern Contour** menu. In the extend option, enter the value you want to change. This time, we decrease the width to 0. We select the retract option and enter the desired value. This way, we can adjust the width of the wheel. ## Adjusting Quality The quality of the wheel will be better when the particle distance is lower, but we leave the distance of particles set to 20 to save time during creation. Eliminate any unnecessary sewing lines. After defrosting the skirt pattern, sew the waist. The skirt pattern is now complete. ## Creating the Back Skirt Pattern Replace the skirt patterns and sew them. Eliminate unnecessary stitches on the wheel patterns. Copy and paste the skirt pattern on the front skirt to create the back skirt pattern. Repeat the same process for the other skirt pattern on the front skirt. ## Final Touches Now we can see the basic skirt pattern. I am going to show you how to attach the skirt pattern to the skirt pattern on the skirt pattern. There are many different options for you to choose from. Use the same method to make the skirt pattern. You will need to change the color of your skirt pattern to the one you like the most. You can also choose the same color for the skirt pattern you want to make. ## Activating the Avatar Activate the avatar by using the **Show the Avatar** menu and the **Activate Avatar** option to activate the arms of the avatar. Establish the skirt pattern at a particle distance of 10 and the wheel pattern at 5 to obtain a better quality. ## Applying Elastic We use the elastic menu for the fruncido. To apply elastic to the lines of the wheels, we can create some more closed folds. To enter a different value, press **Ctrl + Z** to return to the selection, then enter a different value. ## Conclusion This is how you can create a skirt with wheels. Thank you for watching. ```
